title: Certification, security, accessibility, resilience, and release governance
objective: Continuously inventory every route, select the highest residual risk, attack-test it, save expiring proof, and gate release on the integrated product.

obligations.title: Routes, contracts, commands, journeys, accessibility, and source binding form one release receipt
obligations.residualRisk: Isolated tests can pass while the integrated release remains broken or evidence targets different source.

obligations.title: Readiness, dependency degradation, SLOs, synthetics, load, rollback, and disaster recovery gate enterprise release
obligations.residualRisk: A green functional build can still fail under provider loss, load, rollback, or restore.

obligations.title: Regulated release proves least privilege, lineage, retention, residency, immutable audit, and deterministic replay
obligations.residualRisk: A release cannot support regulated operations when authority, lineage, data policy, or replay remains unproven.

slos.indicator: Required release proofs within TTL and bound to current source
